items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Stock Trades At A Premium To Its Earnings Power
items.summary: S&P Global has delivered a 29.2% gain over the past three years. With the shares recently around US$471, the real question is whether that price is supported by the returns the business earns on its capital. Recent news around index partnerships and data services has refreshed the story, but the valuation hinge is still the efficiency with which S&P Global turns invested funds into profits.
